articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch first Starlink deployment mission since problem strikes satellite
articles.summary: The Starlink 6-88 will add 29 broadband internet satellites to the constellation of more than 9,300 in low Earth orbit. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for 12 a.m. EST (0500 UTC).

articles.title: SpaceX, China drive new record for orbital launches in 2025
articles.summary:
Orbital launch activity set another annual record in 2025, although future growth may depend on factors different from those that fueled the recent surge.

articles.title: New Spanish communications satellite suffers ‘space particle’ impact
articles.summary:
A Spanish military communications satellite launched in October was struck by what its operator described as a “space particle,” an incident that could jeopardize the spacecraft’s mission.
